title: HandLive — call_event/action (C→S, ack)
description: CALL-02 API 1 (answer, reject) and CALL-03 API 1 (end). Over WebSocket Android carries out only answer, reject and end; hold, unhold, dtmf and mute always get CALL_HFP_REQUIRED (0.7.1). Android acks as soon as the Telecom method returns; the result arrives as call_event/state. Success ack: #/$defs/ack (empty data); error ack: #/$defs/ack-failure.

call_id.description: call_id of the context the client is showing.

audio.description: Only with answer: where the user takes the call; absent → phone.

action.description: answer (Mac only), reject, end; the HFP-only actions are refused over WebSocket.

hfp-action.description: Actions only possible through HFP commands from the Mac (CALL-03 API 3).

ack.description: Success ack of call_event/action: empty data, sent once Android has called acceptRingingCall() or endCall().

ack-failure.description: Error ack of call_event/action: the codes of CALL-02 API 1 in check order, plus INTERNAL (0.8.1), with the details each code requires.

allOf.description: CALL_HFP_REQUIRED: details.action = the action that was sent.
PERMISSION_MISSING: the missing permission is ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS.
CALL_ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED: details.state = the current state, details.reason per 0.8.1.

not-allowed-details.description: reason: state (answer or reject when not ringing, end when not offhook, or another command for the call_id within 3 s), waiting (a waiting call is present, so the phone is ringing), platform (answer from an iPhone/iPad, checked last, so the phone is ringing), system (Telecom refuses, for example an emergency call, while the phone is still ringing or offhook).
